title: 第一卷 第324章 比就比
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

刘正平脸色一变。

跟钦差比学问？

百姓们立刻来了精神。

“好啊！”

“比就比！”

“我倒要看看，谁的学问大！”

刘正平站在那里，扇子都快捏碎了。

他忽然觉得。

自己好像。

被一步一步引进了别人的局里。

刘正平那天晚上一宿没睡。

不是害怕。

是气的。

一个毛头小子。

“呼。”沈木白松了一口气，她真怕猫咪会抗拒对方，要真是那样可就难办了。

“嘿，有意思，这狗还真能听懂人说话……”赵有才欢喜的不得了，这才敢伸手摸了摸了它，二哈十分不见外的亲了他好几下，弄得他满脸口水。

目光多看了离央两眼后，陈伯忽然想起了在外面遇到的灰袍邪修，想着应该跟这里发生的事有关，便说了出来。

Liu Zhengping's expression changed.

Comparing knowledge with the imperial envoy?

The people immediately became energetic.

"Okay!"

"Compete!"

"I want to see who is more knowledgeable!"

Liu Zhengping stood there, his fan almost crushed.

He suddenly felt.

It seems to myself.

He was introduced step by step into other people's games.

Liu Zhengping didn't sleep all night that night.

Not afraid.

It's angry.

A young boy.

"Huh." Shen Mubai breathed a sigh of relief. She was really afraid that the cat would resist him. If that was the case, it would be difficult.

"Hey, it's interesting. This dog can really understand what people are saying..." Zhao Youcai was so happy that he dared to reach out and touch him. Erha kissed him several times without anyone noticing, making him drool all over his face.

After looking at Li Yang a few more times, Uncle Chen suddenly remembered the gray-robed evil cultivator he met outside. He thought it might be related to what happened here, so he spoke out.
